audit_items.reason: Component mismatch: encode_account is an Execution Layer (EL) specification function. Prysm is a Consensus Layer (CL) client and does not implement EL-specific cryptographic encoding functions.
Component mismatch: decode_receipt and parse_deposit_requests are Execution Layer (EL) specification functions. Prysm is a Consensus Layer (CL) client and does not implement EL receipt decoding.
Component mismatch: parse_deposit_requests is an Execution Layer (EL) specification function. Prysm is a Consensus Layer (CL) client and does not implement EL request parsing.

Component mismatch: EIP-7702 Authorization validation is an Execution Layer (EL) transaction processing function. Prysm is a Consensus Layer (CL) client and does not implement EL transaction validation.

Component mismatch: EIP-7702 Authorization address validation is an Execution Layer (EL) transaction processing function. Prysm is a Consensus Layer (CL) client and does not implement EL authorization validation.

Component mismatch: EIP-7702 Authorization y_parity validation is an Execution Layer (EL) signature verification function. Prysm is a Consensus Layer (CL) client and does not implement EL authorization signature validation.

Component mismatch: EIP-7702 Authorization signature scalar validation (r, s) is an Execution Layer (EL) cryptographic validation function. Prysm is a Consensus Layer (CL) client and does not implement EL signature validation.

Component mismatch: EL requests hash computation is an Execution Layer (EL) function. Prysm is a Consensus Layer (CL) client. While CL clients consume the requests hash via Engine API, they do not compute it themselves.
Component mismatch: extract_deposit_data is an Execution Layer (EL) specification function for parsing deposit logs. Prysm is a Consensus Layer (CL) client and does not implement EL log extraction.
Component mismatch: parse_deposit_requests is an Execution Layer (EL) specification function. Prysm is a Consensus Layer (CL) client and does not implement EL request parsing.
